# Land the completion-verifier runaway diagnostic artifacts on main

## Context / Problem
This ticket's own findings — and its ACCEPTANCE clause — cite
`docs/experiments/diag-runaway-transcript.md`, `docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py`
and `docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py` as the durable record of the measurement. Those
three files were committed in `556708771e` on the branch `impl-10ae-verifier-ctx`, which is
NOT an ancestor of `origin/main`. So on main the cited paths do not exist and a reviewer
checking this ticket's evidence concludes the measurement was never produced. The ticket is
currently unverifiable against main through no fault of the measurement itself.

## Approach
Land the three artifacts on main, unchanged, as their own change — nothing else from
`556708771e` (that commit also carries the 2948 implementation: `completion_banking.py`, the
scaled step floor, the read memo, schema and test changes, all of which belong to 2948's own
review, not here).

Landing rather than de-citing is the right call on the evidence:
- `docs/experiments/` on main already holds exactly this artifact shape — paired live-diagnostic
  driver + findings write-up (`ed6d_live_recovery.py` + `ed6d-live-recovery.md`,
  `f6fc_live_memo_nudge.py` + `f6fc-live-memo-nudge.md`). These match that established
  convention.
- Both scripts are reusable, not throwaway: they are parameterised over ticket / ref / step
  floors / trial count, and they depend only on surfaces that still exist on main —
  `rebar.llm.pai_tools.{filesystem_tools,grounding_tools,rebar_tools}` and
  `rebar.llm.completion._VERIFY_MIN_STEPS` (`completion.py:84`). The budget-anchoring matrix is
  re-runnable against any future change to the verifier's step floor.
- They are content-free by construction: raw transcripts are written outside the repo and are
  never committed, which is why the findings doc records only aggregates.

`docs/` is outside the `ruff check src tests` / `ruff format --check src tests` lint gate, so
the scripts land byte-identical to the reviewed originals (as the existing experiment scripts
in that directory already do — they carry `print()` calls for the same reason).
`docs/experiments/README.md` indexes only the remediation-plan EXP1..EXP-R11 series and does
not list the later live-diagnostic artifacts, so it needs no edit.

## Scope
- `docs/experiments/diag-runaway-transcript.md` (new, from `556708771e`)
- `docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py` (new, from `556708771e`)
- `docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py` (new, from `556708771e`)

No source, test, or configuration file changes. Nothing else from `556708771e` is included.

## Testing
No new testable behaviour: this change adds documentation and opt-in, local-only diagnostic
drivers that are never imported by the package or executed by CI. The relevant check is that
the added files do not perturb the existing gates, which the acceptance criteria below verify
directly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] All three cited paths exist on the change's tree — verified by
      `test -f docs/experiments/diag-runaway-transcript.md -a -f docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py -a -f docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py`
      exiting 0.
- [x] [operator-attested] The added files are byte-identical to their `556708771e`
      originals. Git history is not reachable from the verifier's read-only tools, so the
      blob hashes are recorded in a ticket comment. Locally verified by
      `git diff --quiet 556708771e HEAD -- docs/experiments/diag-runaway-transcript.md docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py`
      exiting 0.
- [x] The change adds ONLY those three files — verified by
      `test "$(git diff --name-only origin/main HEAD | grep -vc '^docs/experiments/diag')" -eq 0`.
- [x] Both scripts resolve their imports against main — verified by
      `python -c "import ast,sys; [ast.parse(open(p).read()) for p in ('docs/experiments/diag_runaway_transcript.py','docs/experiments/diag_runaway_matrix.py')]"`
      exiting 0 and by `grep -q '_VERIFY_MIN_STEPS' src/rebar/llm/completion.py`.
- [x] `make lint` and `make typecheck` still pass on the change's tree.
- [x] The ticket's own findings comments and this description cite only paths that exist on
      main once the change merges — verified by re-reading the ticket after the merge.
